hierarchy.addressing: At tick t, sector=floor(t/120), quad=floor((t mod 120)/30). Within each 30-tick quad, assign address window [floor(localTick*128/30), floor((localTick+1)*128/30)), plus quad*128.
hierarchy.clarification: 360 ticks and 1536 agents are discrete and not evenly divisible; a tick touches 4 or 5 addresses. Counts represent logical scheduled addresses, not 1536 physical optical channels.

preserved.eightLegTun: 4 hydrogen hot orange, 4 nitrogen cold blue, oxygen neutral green body, electron cloud depiction

limitations: The hierarchical schedule is a software addressing scheme. No 1536-agent physical optical chip exists in this artifact.
The 16-mode optical model is unchanged; scheduled logical agent IDs are represented in the homeostasis evidence, not 1536 separate optical network computations.
Original v0.12 homeostasis drift sequence adapted to 3 sector boundaries, 360 logical ticks, same permissive recovery gate.
SHA-256 test on about:blank used a Python hashlib-backed WebCrypto equivalent because local file browsing is restricted; hosted GitHub Pages offers secure origin crypto.subtle.
Recovery results are synthetic deterministic and not physically calibrated.
